MEF PERF 2026-10-07 PASS4: LC-1 Verified large-light correctness blocker: BYTE RenderPass+8 starts at1 for reserved scene-light slot. Each active iterator result with wrapper+F4==0 increments that BYTE at863E89. For stable P eligible additional lights, stored count=(P+1)&255. This is not a measured performance regression; fix before large-count gameplay benchmarks.
MEF v57 IMPLEMENTED 2026-10-08: LC-1 implemented safety policy: scoped helper replaces BYTE count/count-fill, preserves two filtered traversals and projector exclusion, allocates at most255 slots (reserved+first254 eligible), bounds every write, publishes actual initialized count. Excess lights omitted deliberately, not additive-pass equivalence. P<=254 stable ordering/callback trace retained.

MEF PERF 2026-10-07 PASS4: LC-1 overflow point: ADD BYTE PTR [ESI+8],1, no saturation/wide accumulator. P=254 yields255; P=255 wraps0; P=256 wraps1. Iterator follows linked nodes, not this byte count. No eligible-light budget branch was found in this count/fill region.

MEF PERF 2026-10-07 PASS4: LC-1 undersized allocation: MOVZX EAX,AL promotes already-wrapped count; MUL4 overflow detection cannot recover lost high bits. Nonzero count C allocates4*C at863EB3. P=256 gives C=1 and4-byte allocation.

MEF PERF 2026-10-07 PASS4: LC-1 out-of-bounds store: second traversal writes light pointer at array+4*32-bit output index, initialized1 at863ECC and incremented863EE9, without comparing against allocated C. For stable P=256, base+256additional writes total257 pointers into1-slot allocation; first additional pointer already exceeds allocation. No crash reproduction performed.

MEF PERF 2026-10-07 PASS4: LC-1 final truncation: after unbounded fill, byte of 32-bit output index is stored back to pass+8. Widening only allocation count or only this final store does not fix byte-sized downstream representation; keep each emitted pass count<=255 or audit a complete representation change.

MEF PERF 2026-10-07 PASS4: LC-1 zero-wrap distinction: when (P+1)&255==0 (e.g.P=255 or511), array is setNULL and count/fill block is skipped. Do not claim the same direct overflow at that exact boundary. Rendering consequences of publishing zero-light pass require consumer review.

Failure frees unpublished ownership, complements this request's cache key, restoresESI=property and returns through86438B for later retry.
